Alice — thank you for sending these over. Quick notes after a review with Procurement and Legal: 

1) COI limits: we require minimum limits of Commercial General Liability 1M each occurrence / 5M aggregate and Tech E&O where applicable — please confirm these are reflected.
2) Endorsement: we need "Redwood Inference, Inc." listed as Additional Insured and a Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood for the coverage period tied to the PO. If your broker needs exact wording, Legal has a one-line endorsement we can share.
3) Subcontractors: please provide a short disclosure listing any third-party service providers (EdgeOps LLC was mentioned) and whether subcontractors carry equivalent limits. We prefer a CSV with company name, role, and COI status.
4) PO staging: Procurement can stage a conditional PO (placeholder) while endorsements are being finalized — that will allow you to begin technical onboarding. To do that we need: completed vendor profile, remittance details, and confirmation that endorsements are in progress.

Kimberly (Procurement) — can you confirm staging cadence and whether a conditional PO can be created with these artifacts in queue?

Alice — once you send the updated COI/endorsement or DocuSign link we will move this to the evidence queue and push PO staging.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Sent from mailbox: markus_klein]
